## History

Dolly was Anne's unruly cow who was kept at home. After straying into Mr. Harrison's oats field, Dolly caused a confrontation between Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P3](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0003), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P28](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0028), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), +2 more_
